title: Anime Expo 2027
dateNote: Projected from Anime Expo's usual early-July window. Confirm against the official site before publishing.
description: North America's largest anime convention, and the venue where most of the year's major licensing and premiere announcements land. Expect studio panels, English dub premieres, and the industry's biggest exhibition hall.

title: FanimeCon 2027
dateNote: Projected from FanimeCon's usual late-May Memorial Day weekend slot. Confirm against the official site.
description: A fan-run convention with an unusually strong cosplay and masquerade culture, plus a 24-hour gaming hall. Smaller and more community-driven than the industry-facing expos.

title: Anime Milwaukee 2027
dateNote: Projected from Anime Milwaukee's usual late-February window. Confirm against the official site.
description: A midwest winter convention covering anime, gaming and cosplay, with a well-established artist alley and a programme that leans heavily on community panels over industry announcements.

title: FandomVerse Watch Party: Demon Slayer — Infinity Castle
description: A community rewatch of the first Infinity Castle film ahead of the trilogy's next instalment, with a live text thread running alongside it. Recorded discussion notes are linked from the Anime hub.

title: FandomVerse Autumn Meetup
description: An informal community meetup for readers and contributors: seasonal picks, a manga swap thread, and an open floor for anyone who wants to write for the site. The photo shown is from a general convention, not this meetup.
